content.short: Zypto is a DeFi super-app and wallet providing crypto-to-fiat payments and virtual crypto cards.
content.description:
Zypto is a leading multi-functional decentralized finance "super-app" and self-custodial wallet, designed to provide a seamless bridge between digital assets and everyday spending. The platform enables users to manage over 24,000 different tokens across major networks including Ethereum, Solana, and BNB Chain within a transparent and intuitive interface. Zypto standout feature is its integrated payment gateway, which offers virtual and physical crypto cards, as well as mobile top-ups and bill payments directly from on-chain balances.

Through a strategic partnership with MoneyGram, Zypto allows participants to swap between cash and digital assets like USDC at thousands of physical locations globally. The platform focuses on professional-grade security and user sovereignty, ensuring that participants maintain total control over their private keys while benefiting from the speed and efficiency of modern blockchain technology. As a primary portal for mass adoption, Zypto is dedicated to providing the essential infrastructure needed for participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with unparalleled ease and utility.
content.meta: Zypto Wallet provides a multi-chain DeFi super-app with crypto-to-fiat payment cards and global cash-out tools.
